prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent player-car sprite for the actual FORMOSA RUN arcade driving game. Use the supplied triptych only as the source reference for the RED CAR, its two occupants, the rear chase-camera perspective, and its precise painted visual style. Output ONE isolated car on a LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 canvas, NOT a triptych and NOT an entire scene. Extract and faithfully reconstruct the same complete red 1980s open-top wedge-shaped mid-engine GT viewed directly from behind from the slightly elevated chase camera shown in the reference. The car must match the reference's silhouette, proportions, rear deck, black horizontal grille between rectangular paired red/amber tail lights, red body panels, dark black lower bumper, two circular exhausts on each side, wide black tires, black windscreen frame, mirrors, and open cockpit. Driver is seated on the LEFT with short black hair, male; passenger seated on the RIGHT with long brown hair, female. Preserve their relaxed forward-facing driving pose and realistic head-to-car proportions from the reference; both occupants seen from behind. Include their full heads and the entire car, mirrors, tires and exhausts with a small clear margin. Car body occupies about 90 percent of canvas width, centered horizontally, all wheels fully contained. Match the reference visual language: exceptionally detailed semi-realistic hand-painted arcade illustration, rich saturated red paint, natural fine painted texture and controlled subtle brushwork, polished cinematic daylight and reflective metallic detail. This is a refined painted game asset, NOT photography, NOT a generic 3D render, NOT low-poly, NOT anime, NOT a coarse cartoon or flat vector icon. Maintain reference clarity and believable materials. Actual transparent alpha everywhere outside the car and occupants, including the space above and around the body; clean antialiased edges and transparent openings through the windscreen as appropriate. Remove absolutely all road, ground, cast ground shadow, background, buildings, scenery, sky, other vehicles, HUD, numbers and text from the reference. Allow only the car's own internal shading and reflections; no surface or cast shadow beneath it. Rear number plate is blank dark black with no lettering. No logo, no watermark, no baked checkerboard.
